intro.en: Pigtail and branch harnesses divide one main connection into multiple tails or provide a service lead from an existing circuit. Branch geometry and splice construction are central to the design.
intro.zh: 尾线与分支线束把一个主连接分成多个尾端，或从现有回路引出维修与功能支路。分支几何尺寸和接点结构是设计核心。

knowledge.en: Branch current, conductor combination, splice location, sealing and strain relief must be reviewed together. The joint method must suit the conductor construction and project acceptance criteria.
knowledge.zh: 分支电流、导体组合、接点位置、密封和应力防护需要一起审核。接点方式必须适配导体结构和项目验收标准。

notes.en: Provide a branch drawing with datum points, each tail length, conductor sizes, load information, mandatory splice method, sealing requirement and connector orientation. Clarify whether dimensions are measured before or after forming.
notes.zh: 应提供带基准点的分支图、各尾端长度、导体规格、负载信息、指定的接点方式、密封要求和接口方向，并明确尺寸是在成型前还是成型后测量。

delivery.en: The sample is checked on a branch board or dimensional template. Continuity, branch dimensions, splice protection, labels and mechanical checks are performed to the agreed project plan.
delivery.zh: 样品可在分支板或尺寸模板上核对；导通、分支尺寸、接点防护、标签以及机械项目按双方确认的项目计划执行。

subtitle.en: Connector tails, service leads and controlled branch geometry
subtitle.zh: 连接器尾线、检修引线与受控分支结构

lead.en: Pigtail and branch harnesses cover much more than a connector with loose wires. The category includes connector pigtails, open-ended service leads, Y branches, multi-drop looms, sealed sensor tails, repair adapters and power or signal breakouts. Each design must define pin mapping, branch current, splice construction, tail length, sealing, strain relief and the exact datum used to measure every leg.
lead.zh: 尾线与分支线束不只是连接器后面带几根散线。这个小类包括连接器尾线、开口检修引线、Y型分支、多路分配线束、密封传感器尾线、维修转接件以及电源或信号引出线。每种结构都需要明确针脚对应、分支电流、接点方式、尾端长度、密封、应力防护和各支路的尺寸基准。

copy.en: A defined connector and contact system on one end with stripped, tinned, crimped or unfinished leads on the other. Wire colour, cavity number, exposed length and end preparation are controlled for field termination.
copy.zh: 一端使用明确的连接器与端子系统，另一端为剥皮、浸锡、压接或未处理引线。线色、孔位、露线长度和尾端处理需要受控，便于现场端接。

copy.en: Short leads fitted with ring, fork, blade, receptacle or ferrule terminals for switches, studs, busbars and terminal blocks. Terminal size and bend direction follow the real fastening point.
copy.zh: 为开关、螺柱、母排与端子排预制环形、叉形、片式、插簧或冷压端头短线，端子规格和弯曲方向需要匹配真实固定点。

copy.en: One incoming circuit divides into two controlled tails. The joint location, combined conductor area, branch loading, protection and distance from the split to each connector are defined together.
copy.zh: 一个输入回路分成两条受控尾端。接点位置、导体组合、分支负载、防护方式以及分叉点到各接口的距离需要一起定义。

copy.en: Repeated connectors or devices are arranged along a main run for sensors, lights, valves or modules. Drop spacing, cumulative current, addressing and service replacement affect the layout.
copy.zh: 沿主干为传感器、灯具、阀或模块设置重复接口。支路间距、累计电流、寻址方式和检修替换都会影响布局。

title.zh: 板卡与传感器引出尾线

copy.en: Compact leads break a board connector into individual sensor, switch, power or communication tails. Pin function, signal pairing, shield handling and tight-space routing are recorded.
copy.zh: 把板端接口分解为独立传感器、开关、电源或通信尾线，需要记录针脚功能、信号配对、屏蔽处理和狭小空间路径。

copy.en: Replaces a damaged connector end or adapts an available component to an existing circuit without replacing the complete loom. Mating part, pin map and approved joining method remain traceable.
copy.zh: 在不更换整条主线束的情况下替换损坏接口，或把可获得器件接入现有回路。对插件、针脚表和认可接线方法必须可追踪。

copy.en: Main and branch wire sizes are selected from current, voltage drop, duty cycle, temperature, bundling and terminal range. A splice must accommodate the actual combined conductor area without cutting strands or leaving an unstable fill.
copy.zh: 主干与支路线径依据电流、压降、工作周期、温度、成束和端子范围选择。接点必须适配真实导体组合，避免伤丝或填充不稳定。

title.en: Splice sleeves, ferrules and joint systems
title.zh: 接点套筒、端头与连接系统

copy.en: Open-barrel splices, closed-end connectors, ferrules, ultrasonic welds, soldered joints or customer-specified methods are selected from conductor construction and acceptance requirements. Methods are not mixed casually.
copy.zh: 开口接点、闭端连接器、端头、超声波焊接、焊锡接点或客户指定方式，需要依据导体结构与验收要求选择，不能随意混用。

copy.en: PVC, XLPE, silicone, fluoropolymer, heat-shrink, adhesive sleeves, braid or conduit are reviewed against temperature, moisture, chemicals, abrasion and movement at the branch transition.
copy.zh: PVC、XLPE、硅胶、氟塑料、热缩管、带胶套管、编织层或波纹管，需要结合分支过渡处的温度、湿气、化学、磨损与运动审核。

title.zh: 连接器、端子、密封件与标签

copy.en: Housing keying, terminal plating, wire and seal range, cavity plugs, secondary locks and tail labels are treated as one interface system. Loose components are controlled by approved part numbers.
copy.zh: 壳体防错、端子镀层、适配线径与密封范围、堵孔件、二次锁和尾端标签，需要作为完整接口系统管理，散件由批准型号控制。

title.en: Develop from branch drawings and pin tables
title.zh: 依据分支图与针脚表开发

copy.en: The drawing defines a main datum, every branch length, connector view, cavity routing, splice position, protection and labels. Dimensions state whether the harness is straight, naturally laid or formed.
copy.zh: 图纸明确主基准、每条支路长度、接口视图、孔位路径、接点位置、防护和标签，并说明尺寸是在拉直、自然放置还是成型状态下测量。

title.en: Reverse an existing pigtail without hidden assumptions
title.zh: 依据样品开发但不保留隐藏假设

copy.en: A sample establishes visible dimensions and interfaces, while circuit function, ratings, internal joints, plating and sealing are verified separately. The result becomes a controlled part rather than an undocumented copy.
copy.zh: 样品用于确认可见尺寸和接口，回路功能、额定、内部接点、镀层与密封则单独核实，使结果成为受控零件，而不是无记录复制品。

title.zh: 制作便于维修的替换分支

copy.en: Damaged ends can be replaced with defined overlap, staggered joints, labels and protective sleeves. The repair position, access space and joint method are planned so the repaired section can be inspected and supported.
copy.zh: 损坏尾端可通过明确搭接、错位接点、标签和防护套管替换。维修位置、操作空间和接点方式需要提前规划，使修复段可以检查并获得支撑。

copy.en: For wet or outdoor routes, connector seals, individual wire seals, unused cavities, cable entry, joint encapsulation and branch strain relief are reviewed as one sealing stack.
copy.zh: 潮湿或户外路径需要把接口密封、单线密封塞、空腔处理、出线、接点封装和分支应力防护作为一套密封系统审核。

title.zh: 工业设备与分布式传感器

copy.en: Multi-drop branches connect proximity switches, valves, indicator lamps and local I/O along machines and conveyor systems.
copy.zh: 多路分支沿设备与输送系统连接接近开关、阀、指示灯和局部I/O。

copy.en: Connector tails link motors, pumps, heaters, thermostats, switches and control boards while allowing selected components to be serviced independently.
copy.zh: 连接器尾线用于电机、泵、加热器、温控、开关和控制板，使指定器件可以独立检修。

copy.en: Ring-lug, ferrule and terminal pigtails organize connections among breakers, busbars, relays, switches and terminal blocks.
copy.zh: 环形端子、冷压端头和端子尾线用于整理断路器、母排、继电器、开关与端子排之间的连接。

copy.en: Sealed sensor tails, lighting branches and repair connectors are developed for heat, vibration, fluids and restricted service access.
copy.zh: 密封传感器尾线、灯具分支和维修接口针对热、振动、液体与受限检修空间开发。

copy.en: Breakout tails expose individual circuits for measurement, simulation and fixture connection while preserving an approved interface at the equipment side.
copy.zh: 引出尾线把独立回路提供给测量、模拟与工装，同时在设备侧保留批准接口。

title.zh: 自动化单元与机器人末端工具

copy.en: Compact branches distribute power and signals among grippers, sensors, valves and tool changers where branch geometry and repeated movement must be coordinated.
copy.zh: 紧凑分支在线爪、传感器、阀和换工具系统之间分配电源与信号，需要协调分支几何与重复运动。

copy.en: Confirm connector systems, pin map, branch loads, splice method, environment, tail preparation, quantity and required records.
copy.zh: 确认接口系统、针脚表、分支负载、接点方式、环境、尾端处理、数量与所需记录。

copy.en: Verify wires, contacts, housings, seals, splice components, sleeves, labels and approved alternatives before the first article is released.
copy.zh: 首件放行前核实线材、触点、壳体、密封件、接点件、套管、标签与批准替代。

copy.en: Cut and strip to controlled lengths, terminate contacts, prepare conductor combinations and keep strands clean before the joint is made.
copy.zh: 按照受控长度下线与剥线，完成端子端接，准备导体组合，并在制作接点前保持线芯清洁。

copy.en: Set the splice position, branch angles, stagger, sleeves, seals, conduit, labels and connector orientation on the approved fixture or dimensional reference.
copy.zh: 依据批准工装或尺寸基准设定接点位置、分支角度、错位、套管、密封、波纹管、标签与接口方向。

copy.en: Verify continuity, circuit mapping, polarity, terminal seating, branch dimensions and visible protection. Pull or other mechanical checks follow the agreed project plan.
copy.zh: 核对导通、回路对应、极性、端子到位、分支尺寸与可见防护。拉力或其他机械项目依据批准计划执行。

copy.en: The approved sample, drawing, BOM, branch board, inspection points and packaging method become the repeat-production reference.
copy.zh: 确认样品、图纸、BOM、分支板、检验点与包装方式共同成为重复生产基准。

copy.en: A branch joint should not become the bend hinge or pull point. Stagger, sleeve length, support and route are arranged so installation and movement loads bypass the conductor transition.
copy.zh: 分支接点不应成为弯曲铰点或拉力点。通过错位、套管长度、支撑与路径，让安装和运动载荷避开导体过渡。

copy.en: Main conductors, splices and shared terminals are reviewed against the sum and duty cycle of branch loads, contact resistance, bundling and ambient temperature.
copy.zh: 主干导体、接点与共用端子需要结合分支负载总和、工作周期、接触电阻、成束和环境温度审核。

title.zh: 检修位置与接点可达性

copy.en: Repair joints and replaceable tails are positioned where technicians can inspect, support and reconnect them without disturbing unrelated circuits.
copy.zh: 维修接点与可替换尾线应布置在便于检查、支撑和重新连接的位置，减少对无关回路的扰动。

copy.en: Continuity and appearance are standard checks. Pull, insulation, dielectric, ingress or endurance tests require agreed samples, methods and limits. A sealed connector alone does not make every branch waterproof.
copy.zh: 导通与外观属于常规检查。拉力、绝缘、耐压、防护或寿命测试需要约定样品、方法和限值。仅有密封连接器不能代表整个分支都防水。

copy.en: Defined colours, labels, connector directions and branch datums help assembly and maintenance teams distinguish circuits without tracing loose wires repeatedly.
copy.zh: 明确线色、标签、接口方向和分支基准，帮助装配与维修人员区分回路，减少反复查线。

copy.en: A replacement pigtail can preserve the original equipment interface while documenting every new joint, material and circuit change.
copy.zh: 替换尾线可以保留原设备接口，同时记录每个新增接点、材料与回路变化。

copy.en: A branch board and approved dimensions reproduce tail lengths, split points and connector orientation across later batches.
copy.zh: 分支板与批准尺寸可以在后续批次中复现尾端长度、分叉点和接口方向。

title.en: A complete interface instead of loose components
title.zh: 交付完整接口而非散件

copy.en: The connector, contacts, wires, joints, protection and labels arrive as one inspected assembly ready for the agreed installation process.
copy.zh: 连接器、端子、线材、接点、防护与标签作为一个经过检查的组件交付，匹配约定安装流程。

q.en: What is the difference between a pigtail and a branch harness?
q.zh: 尾线和分支线束有什么区别？

a.en: A pigtail usually has a connector or terminal system at one end and free or prepared leads at the other. A branch harness divides one or more circuits into two or more controlled tails. Some products combine both structures.
a.zh: 尾线通常一端带连接器或端子系统，另一端为开口或已处理引线；分支线束把一个或多个回路分成两条以上受控尾端，有些产品会同时包含两种结构。

q.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Provide connector and mating part numbers, pin table, branch drawing with datums, each tail length, conductor sizes, loads, splice and sealing requirements, environment, quantity and inspections.
a.zh: 建议提供连接器与对插件型号、针脚表、带基准的分支图、各尾端长度、导体规格、负载、接点与密封要求、环境、数量和检验项目。

q.en: Can you reproduce a pigtail from a sample?
q.zh: 可以依据样品复制尾线吗？

a.en: Yes, but hidden pin routes, conductor ratings, plating, internal splices and acceptance criteria still require confirmation. A sample is evidence, not a complete specification.
a.zh: 可以，但隐藏针脚、导体额定、镀层、内部接点与验收标准仍需确认。样品是开发依据，不是完整规格。

q.en: Which splice method should be used?
q.zh: 应该使用哪种接点方式？

a.en: The method depends on conductor combination, current, space, environment, available tooling and customer acceptance. Crimp splices, ultrasonic welding, soldering or other methods are reviewed per project.
a.zh: 接点方式取决于导体组合、电流、空间、环境、可用工装和客户验收。压接接点、超声波焊接、焊锡或其他方式按项目审核。

q.en: Can a repair pigtail be waterproof?
q.zh: 维修尾线可以做防水吗？

a.en: It can be designed for a defined ingress test, but the connector, wire seals, unused cavities, repair joints, cable entry and installed orientation must all be included in the sealing review.
a.zh: 可以针对明确的防护测试设计，但连接器、单线密封、空腔、维修接点、出线与安装方向都必须纳入密封审核。

q.en: Which checks are performed before shipment?

a.en: Finished assemblies receive continuity and appearance inspection. Pin mapping, polarity, terminal retention, dimensions, labels, splice protection and other electrical or mechanical checks are added according to the approved plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查。针脚对应、极性、端子保持、尺寸、标签、接点防护以及其他电气或机械项目按批准计划增加。
